detail_script = """import sqlite3
import json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

    d = dict(row)
    print(f"Flight ID: {d['flight_id']}")
    print(f"Airline: {d['airline_code']}")
    print(f"Origin: {d['origin']}")
    print(f"Destination: {d['destination']}")
    print(f"Departure Time: {d['departure_time']}")
    print(f"Arrival Time: {d['arrival_time']}")
    print(f"Duration: {d['duration_minutes']} minutes")
    print(f"Stops: {d['stops']}")
    print(f"Route Type: {d['route_type']}")
    print(f"Status: {d['status']}")
    print(f"Delay Minutes: {d['delay_minutes']}")
    
    if d.get('dates_json'):
        dates = json.loads(d['dates_json'])
        print(f"\\nAvailable Dates: {json.dumps(dates, indent=2)}")
    
    if d.get('cabin_prices_json'):
        prices = json.loads(d['cabin_prices_json'])
        print(f"\\nCabin Prices: {json.dumps(prices, indent=2)}")
else:
    print("Flight not found")

conn.close()
"""
await write_file("./flight_detail_clean.py", detail_script)
print("Script written")

detail_result = await run_command("python ./flight_detail_clean.py")

# Print the clean detail result
print(detail_result)
